race.comment: DIAMOND LUCY (11) was a dominant winner at Bowen last time out and will have derived a bunch of confidence from that victory. Hard to knock mares in form and maps perfectly for this from gate two. Should be right there when the judge calls a halt. The well-related AIRWAVES (4) (half to G2 winner Sejardan) is a two-time winner around this circuit and will be rock-hard fit for this fifth run back from the break. Likely improver with top-three prospects. VOUCHERS (3) is yet to miss a quinella spot in three attempts over this course and distance and gets the services of Wiggins in the stirrups. Include in calculations. Former SA galloper ELITE GATHERING (5) just missed the frame when having the first run for the new stable and will have come on with that run now under the belt. Top-three commodity. DARK FAE (8) is a last-start winner who shouldn't be slept on.
